notes: Gen 9 doubles: Copperajah's Dragon Darts aimed at Vespiquen goes to Cetoddle, whose Follow Me makes it the center of attention, and both darts strike Cetoddle; next turn, aimed at Cetoddle, it goes to Vespiquen under Rage Powder, and both strike Vespiquen. Showdown's Follow Me and Rage Powder turn `smartTarget` off as they redirect; Bulbapedia's Dragon Darts: "If an opponent is the center of attention (such as due to Follow Me), both strikes will target that Pokémon". Vespiquen's Sand Attack makes each target's accuracy check a draw (seed 2: both hit), so a plan that split the darts would draw for a target the move never had (DESIGN.md R-M8-169)

script.p2: move Follow Me, move Sand Attack 1
